content.text: Jason DayPrecision and powerJason Day’s rise through professional golf has been defined by his meticulous technique, powerful performance and competitive spirit on the game’s biggest stages.Formidable competitorJason Day is an Australian golfer whose relentless drive and technical prowess have propelled him to the pinnacle of the sport.From securing his first major title at the 2015 PGA Championship to becoming World No. 1, Day has an ability to deliver powerful performances that has always set him apart. His versatility and sharp focus have made him a formidable competitor on the global golf circuit.Records and major milestonesJason Day began his golfing career with a strong junior record in Australia before quickly ascending the ranks on the PGA TOUR®.His big moment came in 2015 when he captured the PGA Championship with a record-setting 20-under-par score, the lowest in a major at the time. This victory helped him reach No. 1 in the Official World Golf Ranking (OWGR), a position he has held multiple times throughout his career.Day’s powerful drives and accuracy on the greens have earned him more than a dozen victories on tour, including at prestigious events such as THE PLAYERS Championship. In the face of setbacks, he has remained a consistent contender, known for his adaptability and strong mental approach. Day returned to his prime in 2023, effectively going full circle when winning the AT&T Byron Nelson – 13 years after taking victory at the same tournament for his first PGA TOUR® title – and returning inside the world’s top 20.Day also regularly features for the International Team taking on the U.S. Team in the Presidents Cup™.Jason Day became a Rolex Testimonee in 2012.Keep exploring
